name: Local System Accounts Discovery - Linux
description: Detects enumeration of local system accounts via /etc/passwd, /etc/sudoers, or the id command. Adapted (narrowed to avoid overlap with the /etc/shadow-access rule) from SigmaHQ. Source: detections/rules/proc_creation_lnx_local_account.yml, hand-converted from Sigma. vi/vim are matched on process.name rather than process.executable, because update-alternatives resolves them to /usr/bin/vim.basic (same class of bug found live-fire testing the netcat rule -- see docs/build-log.md).
query: any where ((process.executable like~ ("*/cat", "*/head", "*/tail", "*/nano", "*/less", "*/more") or process.name in ("vi", "vim")) and process.title like~ ("*/etc/passwd*", "*/etc/sudoers*")) or process.executable like~ "*/id"
author: Sentinel
